title: Cross-repository adoption contract (shape documentation)
description: The machine-readable connection an adopting repository keeps to the Hub rule source: an immutable Hub commit SHA, a profile, the validator artifacts and their digests, the rule index, and a path to the adopter's own repository_overrides. It carries no rule body. The authoritative validator is tools/check_cross_repo.py:validate_adoption_contract; this schema documents the same shape so drift between the two is caught by scripts/tests/test_knowledge_quality_contract.py rather than discovered later. Procedural checks the validator performs and JSON Schema cannot express (validator_artifacts must equal exactly the profile's required set; a repository-rule override must not copy a line of the Hub rule index) are guarded by that test's negative and mutation controls, not here.

hub_revision.description: Full lowercase 40-character commit SHA. A branch name or a mutable tag is rejected: an adopter must pin to an immutable Hub revision so every adopter fetches the same rule content.

profile.description: Selects the required validator artifact set. Each profile fixes exactly which artifacts the contract must list.

validator_artifacts.description: The Hub validator files this profile depends on, each pinned by SHA-256. The set must equal exactly the profile's required artifacts; JSON Schema cannot express that equality, so the validator enforces it.

rule_index.description: Repository-relative path and heading anchor of the authoritative Hub rule index. The adopter references it; it never transcribes the rules.

repository_overrides.description: Repository-relative path (no leading slash, no .. segment) to the adopter's repository-overrides document. Only repository-specific configuration lives there — never rule body.

path.description: Repository-relative path (no leading slash, no .. segment) to a Hub validator file.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-character SHA-256 digest of the Hub file at path. The validator recomputes it against the Hub tree and rejects a mismatch.

repositoryOverridesDocument.description: The document repository_overrides points at. Kept in $defs because it is a separate file from the contract; the validator reads it from the adopter tree.

overrides.description: At most 16 overrides in total (MAX_OVERRIDES). Per-category limits and the no-copied-rule-body rule are enforced by the validator.

category.description: Per-category caps (OVERRIDE_LIMITS): scan-root 8, exclusion 8, localization-tier 1, repository-rule 8. The caps are counted by the validator, not by this schema.
